• Announced positive topline results from ACACIA-HCM, the pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial of aficamten in patients with symptomatic non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (nHCM). o ACACIA-HCM met both dual primary endpoints, demonstrating statistically significant improvements from baseline to Week 36 in both Kansas City Cardiomyopathy Questionnaire (KCCQ) Clinical Summary Score and maximal exercise performance (peak VO 2 ). o Statistically significant improvements compared to placebo were also observed in key secondary endpoints. o There were no new safety signals identified.

Following positive topline results in ACACIA-HCM, a Phase 3 clinical trial of aficamten in patients with non-obstructive HCM (nHCM), the company plans to submit a Supplemental New Drug Application in Q4 2026.
